entries.title: Add a Mac that has not let your SSH key in
entries.body: When a Mac you add by its address does not let your SSH key in, Firstmate asks once for that user's password, after you say this is the Mac. It uses the password only to let its own key in there, and keeps none of it. A wrong password is said, and a Mac that takes no password says so. From then on Firstmate reaches that Mac with its own key, and asks for nothing.

picture.alt: Settings, Devices, asking once for the password of the user on a Mac that did not let your SSH key in, with Add it and Cancel
